capabilities: List single-line HTML comments from the active note in a sidebar
Jump the editor cursor to a selected scene marker
Create, wrap, or remove scene comments with a toggle command
Copy, select, duplicate, or cut the scene containing the cursor
Filter the scene list and auto-scroll to the current scene
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; installable via BRAT or manual download from GitHub releases. Works entirely locally with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's Outline view is built on headings, so writers who mark scenes with HTML comments have no way to navigate or manage those markers.
summary: Scene outline sidebar that lists single-line HTML comments in the active note and lets you jump to, select, copy, duplicate, or cut each scene.
